title: Healthy Life workspace: focused validation passed
summary: 51 focused tests, TypeScript and lint pass. Existing guided routines and reminder regressions pass. Native device and visual browser QA remain untested; not deployed.

changes.detail: Updated WHO physical activity and NHS strength/running source URLs after reading the linked primary sources. Corrected French/Arabic language-notice encoding.

Formatted new workspace components and model for maintainability. Replaced a generic arrow helper with a function declaration after formatting exposed TSX ambiguity in existing test loaders; the repeated suite now passes.

Eight model/interaction tests cover legacy data roundtrip, invalid input, historical targets, rest/skip denominators, overnight plans, focus recovery, week navigation, confirmed deletion, draft retention and optional preview application.

validation.name: Focused wellness and Change History suite
validation.detail: node --test tests/healthy-life*.test.cjs tests/wellness*.test.cjs tests/change-history*.test.cjs: 51 passed, 0 failed. Includes mocked native/browser reminder tests and DOM interactions.

validation.name: TypeScript
validation.detail: npm.cmd run typecheck completed with no errors.

validation.name: Focused ESLint
validation.detail: All new Healthy Life components and model/lesson files pass; route, engine and types files also passed the initial focused run.

validation.name: Lesson sources
validation.detail: Read CDC sleep/hydration, WHO activity/diet/stress, NHS running/strength and NIH sleep-memory pages. Replaced an inaccessible WHO topic URL and NHS links with the directly checked destinations.

validation.name: Remaining QA and delivery
validation.detail: No native-device or full browser visual/end-to-end run, production build or deployment. New workspace is English; full French/Arabic translation remains pending. Reminders retain existing schedule behavior and do not automatically track custom activity times. Focus prompt is foreground-only.
